derivation.charge: Internal rotational charges +/-1; j_mu=x D_mu y-y D_mu x
derivation.closure: Quadratic test sector only; finite excitation generally sources additional metric and harmonic modes.
derivation.curvature: V_curvature=-R_gamma exp[-(d+2)s]/(2 kappa4); B=15/2 implies R_gamma=15
derivation.field: deltaPhi=x Y_1+y Y_2=psi Y_plus^*+psi^* Y_plus; psi=(x+i y)/sqrt(2)
derivation.meaning: Geometric Kaluza-Klein charge, not yet baryon number; gauge fields from mixed metric components are required when charged modes backreact.
derivation.metric: ds_D^2=exp(-d s) ds_4E^2+exp(2s) gamma_ab dy^a dy^b

dispositions: Homogeneous neutral truncation: no internal rotation modes; it cannot identify the offset with a particle charge.
Round-sphere harmonic completion: derives a degenerate complex pair and quantized internal charges without fitting a coupling or mass.
Invariant Euclidean preparation: zero mean charge, not a tiny nonzero phase; neutral horizon transport preserves this result.
Biased or internally rotating preparation: can carry charge, but its amplitude/current and baryon conversion remain new state data.

euclidean_preparation.condition: Analytic continuation of the positive Gaussian operator on S4 at the late de Sitter vacuum, with internal-rotation invariant boundary preparation.
euclidean_preparation.phase_distribution: Uniform on [0,2pi) for the isotropic complex Gaussian; no coherent ellipse offset.
euclidean_preparation.selection_status: Unique regular Euclidean Gaussian inverse under the stated preparation; horizon regularity alone does not select this state.

horizon.regular_branch: Ingoing branch has arbitrary complex amplitude; regularity supplies no internal phase bias.
horizon.scope: Smooth neutral spherical horizon, constant stationary internal radius. A future collapse history was not specified.

imbalance.fluctuation_scope: Local charge fluctuations need region, mode weights and photon population before a stochastic baryon/photon ratio can be computed. Zero expectation is not identically zero in every local measurement.
imbalance.missing: An inherited charge-asymmetric preparation/interaction and a baryon/photon identification. The geometric charge pair alone provides neither.

inheritance.arbitrary_depth: A charge-conjugation-equivariant channel takes an invariant input state to an invariant state at every depth; regional <Q_n>=0 when the internal conjugation preserves the region.
inheritance.pair_map: a_out=alpha a_in+beta* b_in^dagger; b_out=alpha b_in+beta* a_in^dagger
inheritance.regional_flux: Regional charge may change by current through the boundary; it is not set to zero merely because total charge is zero.

nonuniqueness.caveat: Fixed-background test-field statement. Full gauge/mixed-metric constraints must be restored for backreacting charged solutions; equal external stress is not identical full higher-dimensional initial data.
nonuniqueness.construction: Smooth coherent test-field states related by charge conjugation have equal external stress and opposite charge; convex mixtures vary mean charge while preserving that stress.
nonuniqueness.continuation: Cauchy data and their inherited current, not a coordinate zero, select the nonsymmetric state.

orientation_symmetry.consequence: A proper internal rotation conjugates the charge while preserving the round metric, homogeneous scalar and oriented top-form background. Nonzero background flux does not by itself select a charge sign.
orientation_symmetry.map: P=diag(1,-1,1,...,1,-1) on R^13; flip n2 and n13

sector.scope: Round internal sphere with curvature fixed by the retained B coefficient; linear harmonics on the effective late-vacuum background.

thermal_control.scope: KMS detailed balance at the selected illustrative gap M1. This is neither total abundance nor baryon/photon eta; static frequencies form a continuum.
